title: Hanford's monthly reports expose the material-flow stages without collapsing them
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy Hanford Field Office
summary: Across the May through July reports, DOE separately records waste feed, acceptable-quality glass operations, immobilized LAW container shipment, first permanent disposal, EMF effluent transfer, glass-former deliveries, and laboratory analytical support. Denominator: A stage ledger for the same DFLAW system and reporting series; only feed and effluent contain recurring quantities, while quality, shipment, disposal, reagent, and laboratory stages remain qualitative or event-level.
key_findings: Finding: Across the May through July reports, DOE separately records waste feed, acceptable-quality glass operations, immobilized LAW container shipment, first permanent disposal, EMF effluent transfer, glass-former deliveries, and laboratory analytical support.

Denominator: A stage ledger for the same DFLAW system and reporting series; only feed and effluent contain recurring quantities, while quality, shipment, disposal, reagent, and laboratory stages remain qualitative or event-level.
Boundary: Qualitative stage presence is not an exact mass balance.
Boundary: Shipped containers are not automatically accepted or disposed containers.
Boundary: The reports do not provide exact glass mass, container counts by stage, rejects, rework, downtime, constituent mass, compliance, cost, or residual inventory together.

Next action: Populate one monthly mass-balance table spanning feed, glass, containers, quality release, rejects, rework, downtime, shipment, acceptance, disposal, secondary streams, contaminant mass, compliance, cost, and residual inventory.
why_it_matters: The record replaces isolated snapshots with bounded compatible observations while retaining denominator, threshold, method, and revision breaks.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves entity, cohort, lifecycle stage, period, unit, threshold operator, denominator, revision history, and attribution.
Separates inventory, reliability, adoption, feed, glass, containers, quality, shipment, acceptance, disposal, capacity, baseline, outcome, closeout, implementation, and closure.
Keeps dated checks and exact-artifact retrieval non-blocking.
evidence_limits: Not publicly acquired does not mean nonexistent, withheld, or never submitted.
FTFN public-source research is not agency contact or a submitted FOIA request.
